What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

The core infrastructure challenge for digital creators is finding a way to process payments and deliver products without relying on restricted platforms. Google Apps Script, a cloud-based platform for script writing, offers a solution by providing a seamless integration with NOWPayments for crypto payments and Cloudflare for delivery. This infrastructure not only bypasses platform restrictions but also empowers creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital products. By leveraging Google Apps Script, creators can automate the entire commerce process, from order processing to delivery, without the need for intermediaries.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Google Apps Script architecture for digital commerce automation revolves around the integration of NOWPayments for crypto payments. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments API sends a webhook to the Google Apps Script backend, triggering the fulfillment process. The script then uses Cloudflare Workers to handle the webhook event, which leads to the delivery of the digital product via Cloudflare R2. This architecture enables creators to process orders in under 30 seconds, thanks to Cloudflare Workers handling up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier. The entire process is automated, ensuring seamless delivery and zero manual intervention.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of the Google Apps Script architecture for digital commerce automation are NOWPayments for crypto payments, Cloudflare Workers for webhook handling, and Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery. These components work together seamlessly to automate the entire commerce process, from order processing to delivery. By integrating these components, creators can ensure that their digital products are delivered quickly and efficiently, without the need for manual intervention.
